title: 3rd Stopping Place 2nd Truth From The Comprehensiveness Of Mercifulness To Unity And Oneness

questions.question: In the passage, what is the sun used to help explain?
questions.answer: It helps explain Allah’s unity and oneness.

questions.question: What do bright, clear things show when they reflect the sun’s light and colors?
questions.answer: They show that one sun reaches many things.

questions.question: If someone sees sunlight shining on everything, what would that person understand about the sun?
questions.answer: That there is one sun, and it is the same sun for all.

questions.question: What does the reflection of the sun in shiny things and water drops help people picture?
questions.answer: That one source can be close to many things at once.

questions.question: In the same way, what does mercy reaching all things show about Allah?
questions.answer: It shows Allah is One and has no partner.

questions.question: Where does the passage say signs of Allah’s mercy and Names are found most clearly?
questions.answer: In everything, especially living things, and most especially in people.

questions.question: What does life give to a person in this passage?
questions.answer: A wide connection to the whole universe.

questions.question: If a person is connected to the whole universe, what does that help prove?
questions.answer: That Allah’s oneness reaches all things.

questions.question: What does Allah gather together in each living creature?
questions.answer: Samples of His blessings.

questions.question: Who is given special attention in the passage?
questions.answer: Every individual, especially human beings.

questions.question: How is man described compared with Allah’s blessings?
questions.answer: Man is shown as a small place where many blessings are gathered together.

questions.question: What example from nature is used to explain this gathering into a small thing?
questions.answer: A melon and its seed.

questions.question: Why must the maker of the seed also be the maker of the melon?
questions.answer: Because the seed comes from the melon and is made with wisdom and balance.

questions.question: What does the melon and seed example teach about the world and man?
questions.answer: The One who made the whole world also made man.

questions.question: In the final comparison, what is the cosmos like, what is the earth like, and what is man like?
questions.answer: The cosmos is like a tree or garden, the earth is like a fruit or melon, and man is like a seed.

questions.question: What everyday thing in the sky is used as an example at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The sun.

questions.question: Why is the sun a good example for teaching unity?
questions.answer: Because one sun shines on many things.

questions.question: What kinds of objects receive the sun’s reflection in the passage?
questions.answer: Bright and clear objects, even tiny drops of water.

questions.question: When the same sunlight appears in many places, what does that tell us?
questions.answer: It tells us the source is one.

questions.question: What is compared to light that spreads everywhere?
questions.answer: Allah’s mercy.

questions.question: When mercy covers all things, what truth does that show?
questions.answer: That Allah is One and has no partner.

questions.question: What else is found under this wide mercy besides mercy itself?
questions.answer: Signs of many of Allah’s Names and a special showing of His being.

questions.question: Which part of creation is given special focus after all living things?
questions.answer: Human beings.

questions.question: What special gift does life give each person in the passage?
questions.answer: It gives each person a broad link to the whole universe.

questions.question: What does that broad link help us understand about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is with all things and works in all things.

questions.question: How does Allah show His greatness across the universe and the earth?
questions.answer: By spreading His mercy everywhere.

questions.question: What does Allah place in every kind of living creature?
questions.answer: Small examples of His gifts.

questions.question: What does Allah arrange for living creatures?
questions.answer: Their body parts and tools.

questions.question: Does caring for each one break the order of the whole universe, or not?
questions.answer: No, the whole universe stays in order.

questions.question: Why is the seed example important?
questions.answer: It shows that the one who makes a small thing must also know and make the larger whole it comes from.

questions.question: What final lesson does the passage teach from the seed, earth, and cosmos example?
questions.answer: The Creator of the smallest living thing is also the Creator of the whole earth and the whole cosmos.

questions.question: What main truth is being talked about in this passage?
questions.answer: The truth of Allah’s mercy and oneness.

questions.question: How does the passage use the sun to begin teaching this truth?
questions.answer: It shows that one sun can reach many places.

questions.question: What are two things from the sun named in the passage that are reflected?
questions.answer: Its light and heat.

questions.question: If many objects reflect the same sun, does that point to many suns or one sun?
questions.answer: One sun.

questions.question: What does the passage say is like that sunlight?
questions.answer: Allah’s wide mercy.

questions.question: What does wide mercy covering everything prove?
questions.answer: It proves Allah’s unity.

questions.question: In what kinds of created things are signs of Allah’s Names found?
questions.answer: In all things, especially living things and people.

questions.question: Why are people mentioned in a special way?
questions.answer: Because they show many blessings in a gathered form.

questions.question: What does life cause a person to do in this passage?
questions.answer: It makes the person connected to the whole universe.

questions.question: What does Allah gather into each member of living species?
questions.answer: Samples of His many favors.

questions.question: What does Allah also organize for living beings?
questions.answer: Their parts, tools, and instruments.

questions.question: What fruit example is used to explain a small thing holding a larger plan?
questions.answer: A melon and its seed.

questions.question: Why can’t someone who did not make the melon make its true seed?
questions.answer: Because making the seed needs full knowledge and control of the melon.

questions.question: What is man compared to at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: A seed.

questions.question: What does that comparison help us understand?
questions.answer: That the One who made man also made the whole world.

questions.question: What does sunlight reaching many things help a reader imagine?
questions.answer: How one source can affect many things.

questions.question: What happens in bright objects when they face the sun?
questions.answer: They show its reflection.

questions.question: What can a person learn by seeing the same sunlight in many reflections?
questions.answer: That the sun is one.

questions.question: How is this like Allah’s mercy?
questions.answer: Allah’s mercy also reaches all things.

questions.question: What does mercy reaching everything say about Allah?
questions.answer: That He is One and without any partner.

questions.question: The passage says signs of Allah’s Names appear in all things. Where do they appear in a stronger way?
questions.answer: In living beings, especially in human beings.

questions.question: What does life give that makes a person able to relate to the whole universe?
questions.answer: A kind of broadness and many connections.

questions.question: What truth does that broadness point to?
questions.answer: Allah’s oneness and nearness to all things.

questions.question: How does Allah treat each living individual in the passage?
questions.answer: With special care and attention.

questions.question: While giving that care to each one, what happens to the order of the universe?
questions.answer: It stays whole and orderly.

questions.question: What does Allah gather in each living member of a species?
questions.answer: Examples of His blessings.

questions.question: In human beings, how are Allah’s blessings shown?
questions.answer: In a gathered and concentrated way.

questions.question: What small object is used to picture something concentrated?
questions.answer: A seed.

questions.question: What larger object goes with that seed?
questions.answer: A melon.

questions.question: What must be true about the one who makes the seed?
questions.answer: He must also be the one who makes the melon.

questions.question: If the universe is like a tree or garden, what is the earth like?
questions.answer: A fruit or a melon.

questions.question: If the earth is like a fruit and man is like a seed, what does that prove about the Creator?
questions.answer: The Creator of man is also the Creator of the earth and the whole cosmos.

questions.question: Which example from nature comes first in the passage?
questions.answer: The sun and its light.

questions.question: Why does the passage mention clear and shiny things?
questions.answer: Because they reflect the sun.

questions.question: What do these reflections help us know about the sun?
questions.answer: The same one sun is shining on them all.

questions.question: What is spread over all things in the next part of the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s mercy.

questions.question: What does that great mercy prove?
questions.answer: It proves Allah’s unity.

questions.question: What other truth does it prove besides unity?
questions.answer: That Allah has no partner.

questions.question: What is found in everything under the covering of mercy?
questions.answer: Signs of many of Allah’s Names.

questions.question: Which created beings show this in a special way?
questions.answer: Living things, especially people.

questions.question: What does life do for each individual according to the passage?
questions.answer: It gives each one a wide relation to the universe.

questions.question: What does Allah gather together in every living member of a species?
questions.answer: Samples of all His gifts.

questions.question: What does Allah set in order for animate beings?
questions.answer: Their tools and instruments.

questions.question: How does the passage show Allah’s care for each person?
questions.answer: It says each individual receives special kindness.

questions.question: What example shows a small thing carrying the meaning of a bigger one?
questions.answer: A melon seed.

questions.question: Why is the seed example useful here?
questions.answer: It teaches that the maker of the small part must know and make the whole.

questions.question: What three comparisons are given near the end for cosmos, earth, and man?
questions.answer: The cosmos is like a tree or garden, the earth like a fruit or melon, and man like a seed.

questions.question: What big conclusion should we make from those comparisons?
questions.answer: The One who creates even the smallest living being creates everything.

questions.question: What shining thing is used as a picture at the beginning of the passage?
questions.answer: The sun.

questions.question: What three things from the sun are said to appear in reflections?
questions.answer: Its light, warmth, and colors.

questions.question: When many things reflect the same sun, what does that show?
questions.answer: That one sun is present to them all.

questions.question: What is this a picture of in the passage?
questions.answer: Allah’s unity and oneness.

questions.question: What spreads over all things like light?
questions.answer: The mercy of Allah.

questions.question: What does this mercy show about Allah?
questions.answer: He is One, and no one shares with Him.

questions.question: What can be found in everything under this mercy?
questions.answer: Signs of Allah’s beautiful Names.

questions.question: In which beings are these signs especially noticed?
questions.answer: In living creatures, especially in people.

questions.question: What does life give to each person that is very wide?
questions.answer: A connection that reaches toward the whole universe.

questions.question: Because of that wide connection, what can we understand about Allah’s work?
questions.answer: He is with all things and acts in all things.

questions.question: How does Allah show His glory in the cosmos and on earth?
questions.answer: Through mercy that is one and wide.

questions.question: What does Allah collect in every living creature?
questions.answer: Examples of His blessings.

questions.question: What does Allah carefully arrange in animate beings?
questions.answer: Their tools and body instruments.

questions.question: Who gets special care without harming the order of everything else?
questions.answer: Each individual creature, especially man.

questions.question: What fruit and part of a fruit are used as an example?
questions.answer: A melon and its seed.

questions.question: What does the maker of the seed have to know and make?
questions.answer: The melon it comes from.

questions.question: What is the final main idea of the passage?
questions.answer: The Lord who creates a tiny living being is the same Lord who creates the whole earth and the whole cosmos.
